heading.zh-Hant: 出身、教育與一戰前的軍旅

body.zh-Hant: 據《俄羅斯史百科全書》，弗蘭格爾生於1878年的聖彼得堡，出身瑞典裔的波羅的海家族。他1901年畢業於聖彼得堡礦業學院，隨後入騎兵團當兵，日俄戰爭時志願赴前線，隨一支外貝加爾哥薩克部隊服役。1910年他自總參謀學院畢業，第一次世界大戰期間指揮一個騎兵軍。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Russian History, Wrangel was born in St Petersburg in 1878 into a Baltic family of Swedish origin. He graduated from the St Petersburg Mining Institute in 1901, joined a cavalry regiment as a private, and volunteered for the front in the Russo-Japanese War with a Trans-Baikal Cossack unit. He graduated from the General Staff Academy in 1910 and commanded a cavalry corps in the First World War.

heading.zh-Hant: 內戰初期：志願軍與高加索集團軍
heading.en: Civil War: Volunteer Army and the Caucasian Army

body.zh-Hant: 十月革命後他前往克里米亞，被當地布爾什維克逮捕，險些遭處決。1918年8月他加入阿列克謝耶夫的反布爾什維克志願軍，在鄧尼金麾下升任南俄武裝力量的高加索集團軍司令，1919年7月在察里津戰役中攻佔該城。同年秋天莫斯科攻勢期間，他與鄧尼金為戰略激烈爭吵，被指陰謀、免職並流放君士坦丁堡。
body.en: After the October Revolution Wrangel went to Crimea, where local Bolsheviks arrested him and he narrowly escaped execution. In August 1918 he joined General Alexeyev's anti-Bolshevik Volunteer Army and rose under Denikin to command the Caucasian Army of the Armed Forces of South Russia, capturing Tsaritsyn in July 1919. After a fierce quarrel with Denikin over strategy during the Moscow offensive of autumn 1919 he was accused of conspiracy, dismissed and exiled to Constantinople.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年3月，他被推舉接替鄧尼金，出任南俄白軍總司令，當時白軍已大致退守克里米亞；另有來源把他受命時間記為同年4月。他把軍隊整編並改稱俄羅斯軍，也頒布激進的土地改革。1920年夏他的部隊從克里米亞發動進攻，一度進入北塔夫利亞，但10月蘇俄與波蘭議和後，紅軍集中優勢兵力將其逐回克里米亞。同年11月，他組織有序撤離，把逾15萬名部下及眷屬送往土耳其。
body.en: In March 1920 Wrangel was chosen to succeed Denikin as commander-in-chief of the White forces in South Russia, by then largely confined to Crimea; another source dates his recall to April 1920. He reorganized the army, renaming it the Russian Army, and promulgated a radical land reform. In the summer of 1920 his forces broke out of Crimea into Northern Tauria, but once the Bolsheviks made peace with Poland in October the Red Army drove them back into Crimea. In November 1920 he organized an orderly evacuation of over 150,000 men and dependents to Turkey.

body.zh-Hant: 撤離後，他在1924年創立俄羅斯全軍聯合會（ROVS），同年11月宣布承認大公尼古拉·尼古拉耶維奇對俄國皇位的主張。他是流亡白軍運動的領袖，1928年在布魯塞爾去世。
body.en: In exile he founded the Russian All-Military Union (ROVS) in 1924 and in November of that year announced his recognition of Grand Duke Nikolai Nikolayevich's claim to the Russian throne. He led the émigré movement and died in Brussels in 1928.

heading.en: Origins, staff academy and First World War commands

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，科爾尼洛夫1870年8月30日生於卡爾卡拉林斯克，出身哥薩克。斯巴達克斯教育出版社指出，他1895至1898年就讀總參謀學院，日俄戰爭中獲得嘉獎，1907至1911年任駐華武官。第一次世界大戰期間他先指揮師，1915年在加利西亞被奧匈軍俘虜，次年脫逃，並出任西南方面軍的第25軍軍長；立陶宛通用百科全書則記他自1916年起統率軍。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Kornilov was born on 30 August 1870 at Karkaralinsk and came from a Cossack family. Spartacus Educational says he studied at the General Staff Academy in 1895–98, was decorated in the Russo-Japanese War and served as military attaché in China in 1907–11. In the First World War he first led a division; he was captured by the Austro-Hungarian army in Galicia in 1915, escaped the next year and was given command of the 25th Army Corps on the South-West Front. The Lithuanian encyclopedia dates his corps command from 1916.

heading.zh-Hant: 1917年：彼得格勒軍區與最高總司令

body.zh-Hant: 二月革命後，他在1917年3月至5月任彼得格勒軍區司令，自1917年8月1日起任俄軍最高總司令。他在9月7日要求臨時政府下台，並派克雷莫夫騎兵軍開往彼得格勒，即所謂科爾尼洛夫叛亂。克倫斯基將他免職，他隨後被逮捕，關押在貝霍夫。
body.en: After the February Revolution he was commander of the Petrograd Military District from March to May 1917 and from 1 August 1917 Commander-in-Chief of the Russian army. On 7 September he demanded that the Provisional Government resign and sent Krymov's cavalry corps towards Petrograd, the so-called Kornilov revolt. Kerensky removed him and he was arrested and held at Bykhov.

body.zh-Hant: 十月政變後，他1917年12月逃往頓河，與他人共同組建白衛志願軍，並擔任首任總司令。1918年4月13日，他在葉卡捷琳諾達爾圍攻戰中陣亡。斯巴達克斯教育出版社則記，一發蘇軍砲彈擊中他的農舍司令部而致死。
body.en: After the October coup he fled to the Don in December 1917, helped create the White Guard Volunteer Army and was its first commander-in-chief. He was killed on 13 April 1918 during the siege of Yekaterinodar; Spartacus Educational says a Soviet shell hit his farmhouse headquarters and killed him.

people.nameZh: 米哈伊爾·阿列克謝耶夫

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，阿列克謝耶夫生於1857年11月15日，參加過對土耳其（1877至1878年）與對日本（1904至1905年）的戰爭。《俄羅斯史百科全書》記他1876年完成莫斯科士官學校、1890年完成尼古拉總參謀學院，並在日俄戰爭中於沙河與奉天擔任第三滿洲軍的參謀長。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Alekseyev was born on 15 November 1857 and took part in the wars with Turkey (1877–78) and Japan (1904–05). The Encyclopedia of Russian History says he completed the Moscow Junker School in 1876 and the Nicholas Academy of the General Staff in 1890, and served at Sandepu and Mukden as chief of staff of the Third Manchurian Army in the Russo-Japanese War.

heading.en: Staff posts and the early war

body.zh-Hant: 《俄羅斯史百科全書》記，他1908年升任總參謀部署理軍需總監，1908至1912年任基輔軍區參謀長。一戰開始時他是西南方面軍參謀長，1915年改任西北方面軍司令，該方面軍當年自波蘭突出部撤退，這場撤退戰役成功但損失慘重。立陶宛通用百科全書則記他自1915年3月任西北方面軍司令。
body.en: The Encyclopedia of Russian History says he rose in 1908 to become acting quartermaster general of the General Staff and served in 1908–12 as chief of staff of the Kiev Military District. He began the war as chief of staff of the Southwestern Front and in 1915 commanded the Northwestern Front during its successful but costly withdrawal from the Polish salient. The Lithuanian encyclopedia dates the front command from March 1915.

heading.zh-Hant: 大本營參謀長與最高統帥
heading.en: Stavka chief of staff and supreme commander

body.zh-Hant: 1915年8月之後，他出任沙皇尼古拉二世的大本營參謀長，實際上等同最高統帥。立陶宛通用百科全書記此職自1915年9月至1917年3月；《俄羅斯史百科全書》則記他1916年12月因健康離開大本營，1917年3月至6月又以最高總司令身分回任。科爾尼洛夫事件後，他同意暫時擔任全軍總司令。
body.en: After August 1915 he served as Stavka chief of staff to Tsar Nicholas II, functioning as de facto supreme commander. The Lithuanian encyclopedia dates the post to September 1915 – March 1917, while the Encyclopedia of Russian History says he left Stavka in December 1916 for reasons of health and returned in March to June 1917 as supreme commander. After the Kornilov Affair he agreed to serve temporarily as the army's commander-in-chief.

heading.en: Civil War and the Volunteer Army

body.zh-Hant: 十月政變之後，他在頓河與北高加索同布爾什維克作戰。《俄羅斯史百科全書》記他與科爾尼洛夫成為頓河與庫班白軍運動的軍事核心，據以組成志願軍。立陶宛通用百科全書稱他是1918年志願軍的組織者之一與總司令。他1918年10月8日在葉卡捷琳諾達爾去世。
body.en: After the October coup he fought the Bolsheviks on the Don and in the North Caucasus. The Encyclopedia of Russian History says he and Kornilov became the military nucleus of the White movement in the Don and Kuban that organized the Volunteer Army, and the Lithuanian encyclopedia calls him one of its organizers and its commander-in-chief in 1918. He died at Yekaterinodar on 8 October 1918.

body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Bagramyan was born on 2 December 1897 at Yelizavetpol (now Ganja), was of Armenian descent, and became a Marshal of the Soviet Union in 1955. During the Soviet–German war he served in 1941–42 on the staffs of the South-Western Front and the South-Western Direction, and from July 1942 commanded an army.

body.en: From September 1943 to February 1945 he commanded the 1st Baltic Front, whose troops occupied most of Lithuania between July and October 1944.

body.zh-Hant: 據同一來源，他1945年4月至8月統率第3白俄羅斯方面軍，1945至1954年任波羅的海軍區司令。他1955至1956年與1958至1968年任國防部副部長，1946年起為蘇聯最高蘇維埃代表，1961年起為蘇共中央委員。他1982年9月21日在莫斯科去世。
body.en: The same source says he led the 3rd Belorussian Front from April to August 1945 and commanded the Baltic Military District in 1945–54. He was deputy minister of defence in 1955–56 and 1958–68, a deputy of the USSR Supreme Soviet from 1946 and a member of the CPSU Central Committee from 1961. He died in Moscow on 21 September 1982.

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，諾維科夫1900年11月19日生於科斯特羅馬省的克留科沃，參加過1918至1923年的俄國內戰，1930年畢業於伏龍芝軍事學院。1939至1940年蘇芬戰爭期間，他任西北方面軍空軍參謀長。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Novikov was born on 19 November 1900 at Kryukovo in Kostroma Governorate, took part in the Russian Civil War (1918–23) and graduated from the Frunze Military Academy in 1930. During the Soviet–Finnish War of 1939–40 he was chief of staff of the air forces of the North-Western Front.

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇德戰爭中的空軍指揮
heading.en: Air command in the Soviet–German war

body.zh-Hant: 蘇德戰爭中，他1941年下半年任北方（8月起改稱列寧格勒）方面軍空軍司令。1942年2月至4月他是蘇聯空軍司令的第一副手，1942至1946年擔任空軍司令，1942至1943年並兼任國防人民委員部負責航空的副人民委員。他在史達林格勒戰役、庫爾斯克戰役、攻克柯尼斯堡與柏林戰役中協調多個方面軍的航空兵行動，1944年獲授蘇聯空軍總元帥。
body.en: In the war with Germany he commanded the air forces of the Northern Front (renamed Leningrad Front from August) in the second half of 1941. From February to April 1942 he was first deputy commander of the Soviet air forces, then commander in 1942–46, and in 1942–43 also deputy People's Commissar of Defence for aviation. He coordinated the air operations of several fronts in the battles of Stalingrad and Kursk, the assault on Königsberg and the Berlin operation, and in 1944 became Chief Marshal of Aviation.

body.zh-Hant: 1946至1952年他被關押，依據的是所謂捏造的「航空人員案」。他在1953年獲平反，1953至1956年任遠程航空兵司令，1956年起任高等民用航空學校校長。他1976年12月3日在莫斯科去世。
body.en: He was imprisoned in 1946–52 on the basis of the fabricated so-called aviators' case. He was rehabilitated in 1953, was commander of Long-Range Aviation in 1953–56 and from 1956 headed the Higher Civil Aviation School. He died in Moscow on 3 December 1976.
